verdict.rationale: Docs confirm staged onboarding (hosted or API-only) and that Adyen verifies sellers before paying out (docs-1, docs-6, docs-7, docs-19), implying some minimum-to-start-then-verify flow via Legal Entity Management (docs-8). However, there is no explicit documentation of tunable friction, configurable payout thresholds, or clear per-seller 'requirements-due' status states as described in the story. Missing for 10: explicit requirements-due/capability-status fields, documented threshold-based gating of payouts, and evidence of ops-configurable onboarding tiers.
